indicator.name: Households with access to improved drinking-water source
indicator.description: Percentage of households whose main source of drinking water falls within the improved-source subtotal published by KNBS in 2023/24 Kenya Housing Survey Table 5.14.
indicator.expected_availability_note: Published directly for all 47 counties. This is a household survey estimate of the KNBS improved-source subtotal. Standard errors/confidence intervals are not fabricated, ranking is withheld, and county values are never inherited to constituencies or wards.

observations.source_table: Table 5.14 — Percentage Distribution of Households by Access to Main Source of Drinking Water
observations.notes: Direct KNBS 2023/24 KHS Table 5.14 improved-source subtotal for households. No standard error, confidence interval or sample size is fabricated; ranking is withheld. No value transformation, interpolation, spatial modelling or parent-geography inheritance is applied.
